description: This file is a Node.js script intended to configure and start a development server for a web project, with special handling for Continuous Integration environments. It detects whether it's running in CI, sanitizes environment variables accordingly, and conditionally starts either a static serve or a development server with specific memory caps.

methods.name: isCI
methods.description: Determines if the script is running in a CI environment by checking environment variables.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously with provided arguments and exits the process with the command's status code.
